name: universal-modder
cost: Free (MIT). Generated art, 3D and sound need a fal API key. fal prices are not stated in the README; Sprixen and Voidless are optional paid services
works_with: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode, or any agent that reads Agent Skills
short: Skills and tools that let your coding agent mod PC games you own, from reverse engineering to generated sprites, 3D and sound.
what: universal-modder gives your coding agent a set of AI skills, the fal MCP server and a CLI called `um`. The agent finds the game, works out its engine, reads the real code, builds the mod, makes assets with fal, tests it in the running game and records a video. It also keeps a shared knowledge base of field notes on how specific games were modded.
who: PC gamers and modders who already use a coding agent and want help modding single-player games or servers they host. Skip it for online games with anti-cheat. It refuses those.
needs: Git, Python 3.10 or later, and ffmpeg. `uv` is recommended
A fal API key for generated assets, or fal's browser sign-in, or a local ComfyUI server for images
Blender, if you want 3D models turned into sprites

steps.title: Or in Codex
steps.code:
codex plugin marketplace add rehan-remade/universal-modder
codex plugin add universal-modder@universal-modder

steps.title: Or the skills alone, for any agent
steps.text: Gemini CLI, VS Code with Copilot, Cursor and OpenCode have their own install routes in the README. You can also clone the repo and start your agent inside it.

steps.title: Install the um CLI if your agent didn't
steps.text: The Claude Code plugin puts `um` on your PATH. Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and OpenCode plugin installs don't, so install it once.
steps.code: uv tool install git+https://github.com/rehan-remade/universal-modder     # or: pipx install git+...

steps.title: Store your fal key
steps.text: `um fal key set` asks for the key at a hidden prompt and stores it in the desktop keyring on Linux, or in an owner-only file elsewhere. The agent configs read `FAL_KEY`, so on Linux load it from the keyring before you start the agent.
steps.code:
um fal key set                                                   # hidden prompt
export FAL_KEY="$(secret-tool lookup service fal.ai key api)"    # Linux: before starting the agent

steps.title: Check for prior work
steps.text: Search the knowledge base before you start, to see how others modded the same game.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Mod Terraria: add a homing missile launcher and a tactical nuke that craters the world. Make the sprites with fal.

watch: Generating art, 3D, sound and video uses your fal account. The README doesn't state prices, but `um fal` has a `price` command.
The agent works inside your game folders. It backs up saves first and asks before it drives your mouse and keyboard, installs loaders into game folders or publishes anything.
`um kb pr` opens a pull request with your field note on GitHub. It is meant to run only after you say OK.
The optional three-agent team for long mods uses several times the tokens of one agent.
It refuses to inject into online games with anti-cheat, write cheats against other players, or bypass anti-cheat, DRM or ownership checks.
